email_draft.subject: Critical Exceptions in AP Pipeline for Invoice INV051 - Manual Review Required
email_draft.body:
Dear AP Operations Team,

The automated processing pipeline for invoice INV051 (Document: 01_invoice_pass_case_PO1051_INV051.pdf) has encountered critical exceptions requiring escalation and manual intervention.

Key Issues:
- OCR engine failure due to invalid API key, leading to inaccurate data extraction.
- Vendor name mismatch: Extracted 'Code V051' vs. Master 'Metro Dairy & Fresh Foods LLP'.
- Invoice items do not match PO or GRN lines, preventing quantity, rate, and tolerance checks.
- Additional discrepancies in line and total amount calculations noted in rules compliance.

Pipeline Summary:
- Total Issues: 8 (7 Critical, 1 Warning)
- Failed Stage: Screening (root cause: OCR failure impacting downstream matching)
- Three-Way Match Status: Partial Match - Item Mismatch
- Notes: Screening passed basic checks but detected OCR issues; Matching failed due to item mismatches and name discrepancy.

Please review the attached document and master data for PO1051. Correct any extraction errors and reprocess or approve manually.

Best regards,
AP Automation System
